blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The forensic review of the alleged ₱817.87 million in unexplained wealth of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, examined their assets, income, and three companies linked to them. Lawyer Alexander Cabrera, a forensic financial analyst, confirmed this during his cross-examination on Monday by defense counsel Kristine Ferrer. Ferrer had asked Cabrera about the report’s coverage, supporting documents, and available records. Turning to page 24 of the report, Ferrer identified Metro City Chow Foods Corp., GenCorp Industries Inc., and Cale88 Foods Corp. as the focus of the corporate examination.
